recording_in_progress: Recording in progress ({elapsed}), click to go to recording page
abandon_desc: The recording will be terminated and all data will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
engine_badge_tip_local: Local engine: transcription, voiceprint and summaries run entirely on-device or via your own endpoint. Data never leaves your device. Click to view the data flow matrix
engine_badge_tip_proxy: Trial proxy: cloud ASR and LLM are reached through the project's shared proxy. Business data is never persisted on project servers. Click to view the data flow matrix
engine_badge_tip_selfkey: Own Key: connects directly to the cloud ASR / LLM services you configured. Click to view the data flow matrix
engine_badge_tip_unready: Local engine not ready: local mode is selected but components or models are missing; transcription tasks will be suspended. Click to open settings
engine_badge_aria: Compute engine status: {state}. Click to view data flows
